recommender.name: Destination recommender
recommender.algorithm: Content-based neural network (Keras MLP on traveller + destination + month features)
recommender.metric: hold-out: last 20% of interactions, 989 users, unseen destinations only

demand.name: Booking demand forecast
demand.metric: hold-out (last 20% of days), bookings per day

crowd.name: Crowd forecast (per destination)
crowd.algorithm: Shared LSTM over each destination's monthly demand + calendar month (Keras)
crowd.metric: hold-out: last 6 months, one step ahead; baseline = same month last year
